profile.positioning: I am a Software Engineer at Synapse Solutions, where I contribute to the development of cutting-edge AI solutions for optimizing supply chain logistics. We leverage machine learning algorithms to predict demand, streamline transportation routes, and minimize operational costs for our clients. My primary focus is on building and deploying scalable, robust, and interpretable AI models. I'm passionate about bridging the gap between complex AI systems and human understanding, and that’s why I’ve also developed ClarityAI, an open-source Python library designed to provide clear, concise explanations for machine learning predictions. ClarityAI is built on SHAP values and LIME, offering a user-friendly interface for visualizing model behavior and identifying key drivers of predictions. We aim to empower data scientists and business users to trust and effectively utilize AI in critical decision-making processes. I believe explainability is not just a ‘nice-to-have’ feature, but a fundamental requirement for responsible AI deployment, especially in regulated industries. Synapse Solutions is positioned to become a leader in the logistics AI space, and I’m excited to be a part of that journey.
